RUPEE RISES 7 PAISE TO CLOSE AT 93.44

The rupee ended the day at 93.44 per US dollar, gaining seven paise. In the interbank market it opened at 93.47, moved between 93.25 and 93.57, and settled provisionally at 93.44.

Forex traders said the rupee reversed its morning gains as global risk aversion rose amid fresh US‑Iran tensions and a strong dollar, influencing Indian currency dynamics.
